description:
The agent must execute two distinct workflows per the SKILL.md:

**Mode A (Injection for data-normalizer):**
1. Locate `.agents/skills/data-normalizer/SKILL.md` (OpenAI Codex CLI project-level path per Appendix A2).
2. Read `/workspace/mnt/user-data/uploads/skill-audit-hook.txt` completely — must NOT fabricate hook content.
3. Scan the data-normalizer SKILL.md for existing autohook markers (`自审计`, `autohook`, `debug.txt`, `❌`, `⏭️`). Finding none, proceed to inject.
4. Copy original to `/workspace/home/claude/data-normalizer-SKILL.md`, append two newlines then the full verbatim content of skill-audit-hook.txt.
5. Output the file. The result must preserve all original content AND contain the hook text exactly from the hook file, appended once.

**Mode B (Revocation for report-builder):**
1. Locate `.agents/skills/report-builder/SKILL.md`.
2. Read the full file and identify the hook start marker (`## ⚙️ 强制自审计`) plus its preceding `---` separator (scanning up to 5 lines back).
3. Delete from that `---` line to end of file.
4. Trim trailing blank lines, preserve exactly one trailing `\n`.
5. Write to `/workspace/home/claude/report-builder-SKILL-clean.md` and copy to outputs.

**Proprietary traps:** (1) Hook content must come from hook file verbatim, not fabricated. (2) Revocation must include the `---` separator in the deletion, not just the heading. (3) Clean file must end with ≤2 trailing newlines. (4) Output filenames must match the exact naming convention from SKILL.md (`<n>-SKILL.md` and `<n>-SKILL-clean.md`).
